detaileddescription.para: Our DIEs get freed after every DebugMapObject has been processed, thus the FoldingSet we use to unique DIEAbbrevs cannot refer to the instances hold by the DIEs. When we encounter an abbreviation that we don't know, we create a permanent copy of it.

detaileddescription.para: Read the frame info stored in the object, and emit the patched frame descriptions for the resulting file.
This is actually pretty easy as the data of the CIEs and FDEs can be considered as black boxes and moved as is. The only thing to do is to patch the addresses in the headers.
